journal.en: The manuscript was rejected by three journals before its acceptance.
journal.zh: 这篇稿件在录用前被三家期刊拒稿。

journal.en: She serves on the editorial board of a leading sociology journal.
journal.zh: 她在一份重要的社会学期刊的编辑委员会任职。

journal.en: The researcher kept a field journal throughout the expedition.
journal.zh: 这位研究员在考察期间一直坚持写野外日志。

manuscript.en: Reviewers requested major revisions to the manuscript.
manuscript.zh: 审稿人要求对稿件进行大修。

manuscript.en: The medieval manuscript was digitized for the online archive.
manuscript.zh: 这份中世纪手稿已被数字化并收入在线档案。

manuscript.en: Authors must declare competing interests when submitting a manuscript.
manuscript.zh: 作者投稿时必须声明利益冲突。

thesis.en: Her doctoral thesis examines migration in coastal cities.
thesis.zh: 她的博士论文研究沿海城市的迁移问题。

thesis.en: The paper's central thesis is that institutions shape technological change.
thesis.zh: 这篇论文的中心论点是制度塑造技术变革。

thesis.en: He defended his master's thesis in the spring semester.
thesis.zh: 他在春季学期完成了硕士论文答辩。

appendix.en: The full questionnaire is reproduced in Appendix B.
Two appendix tables contain the derivation and robustness checks.
appendix.zh: 两张附录表包含推导过程与稳健性检验。

appendix.en: The surgeon removed the patient's inflamed appendix.
appendix.zh: 外科医生切除了患者发炎的阑尾。

footnote.en: The definition appears in a footnote on the first page.
footnote.zh: 该定义出现在第一页的一个脚注里。

footnote.en: She footnoted every quotation to satisfy the reviewers.
footnote.zh: 她给每条引文都加了脚注，以满足审稿人的要求。

footnote.en: The disputed figure is discussed only in a footnote.
footnote.zh: 那处有争议的数字只在脚注里讨论。

bibliography.en: The annotated bibliography lists over two hundred sources.
bibliography.zh: 这份带注解的参考文献目录列出了两百多个来源。

bibliography.en: A selective bibliography closes each chapter.
bibliography.zh: 每章末尾附有一个精选书目。

bibliography.en: Check the bibliography for the correct citation format.
bibliography.zh: 请核对参考文献目录中的引用格式是否正确。

symposium.en: The annual symposium brings together researchers from four disciplines.
symposium.zh: 这个年度研讨会汇集了四个学科的研究者。

symposium.en: Selected papers from the symposium appear in a special issue.
symposium.zh: 研讨会的精选论文刊于某期特刊。

symposium.en: He presented preliminary results at the graduate symposium.
symposium.zh: 他在研究生研讨会上展示了初步结果。

proceedings.en: The paper appeared in the conference proceedings rather than a journal.
proceedings.zh: 这篇论文发表于会议论文集而非期刊。

proceedings.en: Legal proceedings against the company are still pending.
proceedings.zh: 对该公司的法律诉讼仍在进行中。

proceedings.en: Proceedings of the workshop were published within three months.
proceedings.zh: 研讨会的论文集在三个月内出版。

curriculum.en: The revised curriculum adds a required course in research ethics.
curriculum.zh: 修订后的课程体系增加了一门必修的研究伦理课。

curriculum.en: Curriculum reform aimed to reduce reliance on rote memorization.
curriculum.zh: 课程改革旨在减少对死记硬背的依赖。

curriculum.en: Schools differ widely in how the national curriculum is implemented.
curriculum.zh: 各校在落实国家课程方面的差异很大。

syllabus.en: The syllabus lists weekly readings and assessment deadlines.
syllabus.zh: 教学大纲列出了每周阅读材料和考核截止日期。

syllabus.en: Instructors may adapt the syllabus to local conditions.
syllabus.zh: 授课教师可根据当地情况调整教学大纲。

syllabus.en: Ethics training now appears in the first-year syllabus.
syllabus.zh: 伦理训练现在已列入一年级的教学大纲。

pedagogy.en: The program trains teachers in evidence-based pedagogy.
pedagogy.zh: 该项目培训教师掌握循证教学法。

pedagogy.en: Digital pedagogy raises new questions about assessment.
pedagogy.zh: 数字化教学法给评估提出了新的问题。

pedagogy.en: Her research links classroom pedagogy to student motivation.
pedagogy.zh: 她的研究把课堂教学法与学生动机联系起来。

faculty.en: The faculty voted to adopt the new grading policy.
faculty.zh: 全体教员投票通过了新的评分政策。

faculty.en: She joined the faculty of the economics department in 2019.
faculty.zh: 她于 2019 年加入该校经济学系任教。

faculty.en: Faculty members supervise both master's and doctoral students.
faculty.zh: 教员们同时指导硕士生和博士生。

mentor.en: Each incoming student is paired with a faculty mentor.
mentor.zh: 每名新生都配有一位教师导师。

mentor.en: The senior scientists mentor junior colleagues through co-authorship.
mentor.zh: 资深科学家通过合作发表论文来指导年轻同事。

mentor.en: A good mentor provides both critique and encouragement.
mentor.zh: 好的导师既给批评也给鼓励。

doctoral.en: Doctoral candidates complete coursework before the dissertation stage.
doctoral.zh: 博士候选人在论文阶段之前先修完课程。

doctoral.en: The grant covers doctoral research on wetland restoration.
doctoral.zh: 这笔资助覆盖关于湿地恢复的博士研究。

doctoral.en: Doctoral training increasingly includes data management skills.
doctoral.zh: 博士培养越来越包括数据管理技能。

ideology.en: The study asks how ideology shapes policy preferences.
ideology.zh: 该研究探讨意识形态如何塑造政策偏好。

ideology.en: Textbook analysis reveals the ideology embedded in the curriculum.
ideology.zh: 教科书分析揭示了课程中蕴含的意识形态。

ideology.en: The movement appealed to voters across ideology and class.
ideology.zh: 这场运动吸引了跨越意识形态和阶层的选民。

hegemony.en: The essay examines the cultural hegemony of the metropolitan elite.
hegemony.zh: 这篇文章考察了大都市精英的文化霸权。

hegemony.en: Regional hegemony depended on control of trade routes.
hegemony.zh: 地区霸权依赖于对贸易路线的控制。

hegemony.en: Hegemony is maintained through consent as much as coercion.
hegemony.zh: 霸权的维持既靠强制，也靠同意。

bureaucracy.en: Grant administration is slowed by layers of bureaucracy.
bureaucracy.zh: 层层官僚体制拖慢了经费管理。

bureaucracy.en: The reform aimed to make the bureaucracy more responsive.
bureaucracy.zh: 这项改革旨在让官僚机构更快速地回应。

bureaucracy.en: Weber described bureaucracy as the most rational form of organization.
bureaucracy.zh: 韦伯将官僚制描述为最理性的组织形式。

marginalize.en: Rising rents marginalize low-income households in central districts.
marginalize.zh: 上涨的租金使低收入家庭在中心城区被边缘化。

marginalize.en: The design marginalized the voices of part-time students.
marginalize.zh: 该设计把非全日制学生的声音边缘化了。

marginalize.en: Marginalized communities bear the greatest environmental burden.
marginalize.zh: 被边缘化的社区承受着最重的环境负担。

stigmatize.en: Labeling policies can stigmatize the very people they intend to help.
stigmatize.zh: 贴标签式的政策可能污名化其本想帮助的人。

stigmatize.en: Media coverage often stigmatizes mental illness.
stigmatize.zh: 媒体报道常常污名化精神疾病。

stigmatize.en: Participants feared being stigmatized within their community.
stigmatize.zh: 参与者担心在自己社区里被污名化。

urbanization.en: Rapid urbanization has outpaced the provision of sanitation.
urbanization.zh: 快速的城市化已使环卫设施的供给跟不上。

urbanization.en: The century of urbanization redrew the country's economic map.
urbanization.zh: 这一个世纪的城市化重画了该国的经济地图。

urbanization.en: Urbanization explains part of the decline in agricultural employment.
urbanization.zh: 城市化可以部分解释农业就业的下降。

globalization.en: Globalization has intensified competition among port cities.
globalization.zh: 全球化加剧了港口城市之间的竞争。

globalization.en: Critics argue that globalization widened within-country inequality.
globalization.zh: 批评者认为全球化扩大了一国内部的不平等。

globalization.en: The book traces globalization back to premodern trade networks.
globalization.zh: 该书把全球化追溯到前现代的贸易网络。

citizenship.en: The state grants citizenship to children born on its territory.
citizenship.zh: 该国向在其境内出生的儿童授予公民身份。

citizenship.en: Service learning is said to foster democratic citizenship.
citizenship.zh: 服务式学习被认为能培养民主公民素养。

citizenship.en: Dual citizenship is permitted under the new statute.
citizenship.zh: 新法律允许双重公民身份。

electorate.en: The electorate approved the constitutional amendment narrowly.
electorate.zh: 全体选民以微弱优势通过了宪法修正案。

electorate.en: Urban voters now dominate the national electorate.
electorate.zh: 城市选民如今在全国选民中占主导。

electorate.en: Turnout was highest among an older, rural electorate.
electorate.zh: 年长的农村选民群体投票率最高。

referendum.en: The referendum on independence was held after years of negotiation.
referendum.zh: 经过多年谈判，独立公投终于举行。

referendum.en: A referendum is required before the tax can be raised.
referendum.zh: 增税之前必须举行全民公投。

referendum.en: Local referendums on school funding have become more frequent.
referendum.zh: 关于学校经费的地方公投变得更频繁了。

treaty.en: The treaty binds signatories to verifiable emission cuts.
treaty.zh: 该条约约束签署方进行可核查的减排。

treaty.en: Ratification of the treaty required a two-thirds majority.
treaty.zh: 该条约的批准需要三分之二多数。

treaty.en: Border adjustments were negotiated in a separate treaty.
treaty.zh: 边境调整在另一项条约中协商确定。

ratify.en: Parliament ratified the accord after months of debate.
ratify.zh: 经过数月辩论，议会批准了该协定。

ratify.en: Only twelve states have ratified the convention so far.
ratify.zh: 迄今只有十二个国家批准了该公约。
修正案获得了一致批准。

statute.en: The statute requires disclosure of all external funding.
statute.zh: 该成文法要求披露所有外部资助。

statute.en: Courts interpreted the statute broadly in later cases.
statute.zh: 后来的判例对这一法令作了宽泛解释。

statute.en: The limitation period is set by statute, not by contract.
statute.zh: 诉讼时效由法律规定，而非合同约定。

jurisdiction.en: The data center falls under the jurisdiction of two regulators.
jurisdiction.zh: 该数据中心受两个监管机构管辖。

jurisdiction.en: The court dismissed the case for lack of jurisdiction.
jurisdiction.zh: 法院以缺乏管辖权为由驳回了此案。
执法力度在不同司法辖区差异很大。

litigation.en: Patent litigation can outlast the underlying technology.
litigation.zh: 专利诉讼的时间可能超过其背后的技术寿命。

litigation.en: The settlement ended a decade of litigation.
litigation.zh: 和解结束了长达十年的诉讼。

litigation.en: Clear contracts reduce the risk of litigation.
litigation.zh: 清晰的合同能降低诉讼风险。

tariff.en: The new tariff raised the price of imported steel.
tariff.zh: 新关税抬高了进口钢材的价格。

tariff.en: Tariffs on solar panels were phased down over five years.
tariff.zh: 太阳能电池板的关税在五年内逐步下调。

tariff.en: Retaliatory tariffs hit agricultural exports hardest.
tariff.zh: 报复性关税对农产品出口的打击最大。

subsidy.en: The subsidy lowers the effective cost of childcare.
subsidy.zh: 这项补贴降低了托育的实际成本。
化石燃料补贴扭曲了能源市场。

subsidy.en: Farm subsidies were redirected toward conservation practices.
subsidy.zh: 农业补贴被转用于保护性耕作。

inflation.en: Inflation eroded the real value of the stipend.
inflation.zh: 通货膨胀侵蚀了助学金的实际价值。

inflation.en: Central banks raised rates to contain inflation.
inflation.zh: 央行为遏制通货膨胀而加息。

inflation.en: Grade inflation complicates comparisons across cohorts.
inflation.zh: 分数膨胀使不同队列之间的比较变得复杂。

monetary.en: The monetary authority signaled a pause in rate increases.
monetary.zh: 货币当局示意暂停加息。

monetary.en: Monetary union removed exchange-rate risk within the bloc.
monetary.zh: 货币联盟消除了集团内部的汇率风险。

monetary.en: Compensation was awarded in both monetary and non-monetary forms.
monetary.zh: 补偿以货币与非货币两种形式给予。

fiscal.en: The fiscal stimulus package passed in the spring.
fiscal.zh: 财政刺激方案于春季获得通过。

fiscal.en: Fiscal decentralization shifted spending power to provinces.
fiscal.zh: 财政分权把支出权力下放到各省。

fiscal.en: The report audits fiscal year 2023 expenditures.
fiscal.zh: 该报告审计了 2023 财政年度的支出。

monopoly.en: The utility holds a legal monopoly on electricity distribution.
monopoly.zh: 该公用事业公司在配电上拥有法定专营权。

monopoly.en: Regulators broke up the monopoly in the 1980s.
monopoly.zh: 监管机构在 20 世纪 80 年代拆分了这一垄断。

monopoly.en: The state monopoly on broadcasting ended in 1990.
monopoly.zh: 国家广播垄断于 1990 年终结。

neural.en: Neural activity in the prefrontal cortex predicted task performance.
neural.zh: 前额叶皮层的神经活动预测了任务表现。

neural.en: The model uses a neural network trained on labeled images.
neural.zh: 该模型使用在标注图像上训练的神经网络。

neural.en: Neural pathways for reward develop during adolescence.
neural.zh: 奖赏相关的神经通路在青春期发育。

neuron.en: A single neuron can receive inputs from thousands of others.
neuron.zh: 单个神经元可以接收来自数千个其他神经元的输入。

neuron.en: Mirror neurons fire both when acting and when observing.
neuron.zh: 镜像神经元在行动和观察时都会放电。

neuron.en: The staining method made individual neurons visible.
neuron.zh: 这种染色方法使单个神经元变得可见。

polymer.en: The polymer degrades within six months in compost.
polymer.zh: 这种聚合物在堆肥中六个月内降解。

polymer.en: Conductive polymers enable flexible electronic devices.
polymer.zh: 导电聚合物使柔性电子器件成为可能。

polymer.en: Chain length determines the polymer's mechanical properties.
polymer.zh: 链长决定了聚合物的力学性质。

catalyst.en: The catalyst lowers the activation energy of the reaction.
catalyst.zh: 该催化剂降低了反应的活化能。

catalyst.en: The crisis acted as a catalyst for institutional reform.
catalyst.zh: 这场危机成为制度改革的催化剂。

catalyst.en: Platinum remains the most studied catalyst for fuel cells.
catalyst.zh: 铂仍是燃料电池中被研究最多的催化剂。

enzyme.en: The enzyme catalyzes the breakdown of starch into sugars.
enzyme.zh: 这种酶催化淀粉分解为糖。

enzyme.en: Enzyme activity peaked at forty degrees Celsius.
enzyme.zh: 酶活性在 40 摄氏度时达到峰值。

enzyme.en: A single gene mutation disabled the enzyme entirely.
enzyme.zh: 单个基因突变使这种酶完全失活。

protein.en: The protein folds into a stable three-dimensional structure.
protein.zh: 该蛋白质折叠成稳定的三维结构。

protein.en: Dietary protein requirements rise with physical training.
protein.zh: 随着体能训练的增加，膳食蛋白质需求也上升。

protein.en: Misfolded proteins accumulate in the affected tissue.
protein.zh: 错误折叠的蛋白质在受累组织中累积。

genome.en: The team sequenced the entire genome of the landrace.
genome.zh: 团队对这一地方品种的全基因组进行了测序。

genome.en: Comparing genomes across species reveals conserved regions.
genome.zh: 跨物种比较基因组可揭示保守区域。

genome.en: Only a fraction of the genome codes for proteins.
genome.zh: 基因组中只有一小部分编码蛋白质。

metabolism.en: The drug is cleared from the body by hepatic metabolism.
metabolism.zh: 该药物经肝脏代谢清除出体外。

metabolism.en: Basal metabolism declines gradually with age.
metabolism.zh: 基础代谢随年龄增长逐渐下降。

metabolism.en: Cold exposure alters metabolism in hibernating mammals.
metabolism.zh: 寒冷暴露会改变冬眠哺乳动物的代谢。

toxic.en: The solvent is toxic to aquatic organisms even at low doses.
toxic.zh: 这种溶剂即使在低剂量下对水生生物也有毒。

toxic.en: Toxic metals accumulated in the river sediment.
toxic.zh: 有毒金属在河底沉积物中累积。

toxic.en: The panel reviewed evidence linking toxic stress to learning delays.
toxic.zh: 专家组审查了毒性应激与学习延迟相关的证据。

emission.en: Carbon emissions fell 4% during the transport strike.
emission.zh: 运输罢工期间碳排放下降了 4%。

emission.en: New engines must meet stricter emission standards.
emission.zh: 新发动机必须满足更严格的排放标准。

emission.en: The inventory tracks emissions by sector and fuel type.
emission.zh: 这份清单按部门和燃料类型追踪排放。

climate.en: Climate models project more frequent heat extremes this century.
climate.zh: 气候模式预计本世纪极端高温会更频繁。

climate.en: A supportive institutional climate encourages replication studies.
climate.zh: 支持性的机构氛围鼓励重复研究。

climate.en: Vineyard choice follows both soil and climate conditions.
climate.zh: 葡萄园选址同时取决于土壤与气候条件。

renewable.en: Renewable capacity additions exceeded all fossil additions last year.
renewable.zh: 去年可再生能源新增装机超过所有化石能源。

renewable.en: The grid must balance intermittent renewable supply.
renewable.zh: 电网必须平衡间歇性的可再生供应。

renewable.en: Subsidies accelerated the shift to renewable electricity.
renewable.zh: 补贴加速了向可再生电力的转型。

semiconductor.en: The semiconductor industry concentrates fabrication in a few regions.
semiconductor.zh: 半导体行业把制造集中在少数地区。

semiconductor.en: Doping changes the electrical behavior of the semiconductor.
semiconductor.zh: 掺杂会改变半导体的电学行为。

semiconductor.en: Chips are built on wafers of purified semiconductor material.
semiconductor.zh: 芯片以高纯半导体材料晶圆为基础制造。

database.en: All participants were assigned identifiers in the study database.
database.zh: 所有参与者都在研究数据库中被分配了标识符。

database.en: The database records every protocol deviation.
database.zh: 该数据库记录每一次方案偏离。

database.en: Queries against the national database took days to approve.
database.zh: 查询国家数据库需要数天才能获得批准。

bandwidth.en: Video transmission requires far more bandwidth than text.
bandwidth.zh: 视频传输所需的带宽远高于文本。

bandwidth.en: The lab lacks the bandwidth to process new submissions quickly.
bandwidth.zh: 实验室没有足够的精力快速处理新提交的任务。

bandwidth.en: Rural clinics cite bandwidth limits as a barrier to telehealth.
bandwidth.zh: 农村诊所把带宽限制列为远程医疗的障碍。

clinical.en: The phase-two clinical trial enrolled 240 patients.
clinical.zh: 二期临床试验入组了 240 名患者。

clinical.en: Clinical guidelines now recommend screening at age forty-five.
clinical.zh: 临床指南现在建议从 45 岁开始筛查。

clinical.en: Benefits observed in the laboratory may not translate into clinical practice.
clinical.zh: 实验室观察到的获益未必能转化为临床实践。

diagnosis.en: Early diagnosis substantially improves five-year survival.
diagnosis.zh: 早期诊断能显著提高五年生存率。

diagnosis.en: The diagnosis was confirmed by two independent raters.
diagnosis.zh: 诊断由两名独立评定者确认。

diagnosis.en: Criteria for the diagnosis of the syndrome were revised in 2013.
diagnosis.zh: 该综合征的诊断标准于 2013 年修订。

epidemic.en: The obesity epidemic has spread to younger age groups.
epidemic.zh: 肥胖流行已蔓延到更年轻的年龄组。

epidemic.en: The 1918 influenza epidemic infected a third of the population.
epidemic.zh: 1918 年的流感大流行感染了三分之一的人口。

epidemic.en: An epidemic of misinformation accompanied the outbreak.
epidemic.zh: 伴随疫情暴发的是一场错误信息的流行。

pandemic.en: The pandemic disrupted schooling for more than a year.
pandemic.zh: 疫情大流行使学校教育中断了一年多。

pandemic.en: Pandemic preparedness plans were updated after the review.
pandemic.zh: 评审之后，大流行防备计划得到了更新。

pandemic.en: Remote surveys expanded rapidly during the pandemic.
pandemic.zh: 疫情期间远程调查迅速扩大。

outbreak.en: The outbreak was traced to a single contaminated well.
outbreak.zh: 这次疫情暴发被追查到一口受污染的水井。

outbreak.en: Rapid sequencing helped contain the outbreak within weeks.
outbreak.zh: 快速测序帮助疫情在数周内得到控制。

outbreak.en: Outbreaks of cholera follow the seasonal floods.
outbreak.zh: 霍乱暴发随季节性洪水而来。

confidence interval.en: The confidence interval for the odds ratio spans one.
confidence interval.zh: 比值比的置信区间跨越 1。

confidence interval.en: We report a 95% confidence interval for every estimate.
confidence interval.zh: 我们对每个估计值都报告 95% 置信区间。

confidence interval.en: A narrower confidence interval follows from the larger sample.
confidence interval.zh: 更大的样本带来更窄的置信区间。

standard deviation.en: Scores fell within one standard deviation of the mean.
standard deviation.zh: 分数落在均值的一个标准差之内。

standard deviation.en: The treatment group differed by nearly two standard deviations.
standard deviation.zh: 处理组的差异接近两个标准差。

standard deviation.en: Report the standard deviation alongside every mean.
standard deviation.zh: 每个均值旁边都应报告标准差。

chronic.en: Chronic pain affects sleep and mood in most patients.
chronic.zh: 慢性疼痛影响大多数患者的睡眠与情绪。

chronic.en: The region suffers chronic underinvestment in maintenance.
chronic.zh: 该地区长期存在养护投入不足的问题。

chronic.en: Chronic exposure to noise impairs reading development.
chronic.zh: 长期噪声暴露会损害阅读能力的发展。

acute.en: The acute phase of the illness lasts about two weeks.
acute.zh: 该病的急性期持续约两周。

acute.en: There is an acute shortage of trained nurses in rural areas.
acute.zh: 农村地区训练有素的护士严重短缺。

acute.en: Her acute observation of classroom talk enriched the analysis.
acute.zh: 她对课堂话语的敏锐观察丰富了这项分析。

episodic.en: The disorder follows an episodic course with symptom-free intervals.
episodic.zh: 该障碍呈发作性病程，症状之间有无症状间歇期。

episodic.en: Memory is both episodic and semantic in this taxonomy.
episodic.zh: 在这一分类里，记忆既包括情景记忆也包括语义记忆。

episodic.en: Episodic rainfall makes multi-year averages essential.
episodic.zh: 降雨呈阵发性，因此多年平均值必不可少。

sustained.en: Sustained attention declines measurably after twenty minutes.
sustained.zh: 持续注意在二十分钟后出现可测量的下降。

sustained.en: The policy produced sustained gains in completion rates.
sustained.zh: 该政策带来了完成率的持续提升。

sustained.en: Wind speeds remained sustained above fifty kilometers per hour.
sustained.zh: 风速持续保持在每小时 50 公里以上。

intermittent.en: Intermittent connectivity hampered data collection in the field.
intermittent.zh: 间歇性的网络连接妨碍了实地数据采集。

intermittent.en: Patients reported intermittent pain rather than constant discomfort.
intermittent.zh: 患者报告的是间歇性疼痛而非持续不适。

intermittent.en: The stream flows intermittently during the dry season.
intermittent.zh: 这条溪流在旱季间歇性断流。

cognitive.en: Cognitive load theory explains why worked examples help novices.
cognitive.zh: 认知负荷理论解释了为什么样例能帮助新手。

cognitive.en: Bilingual experience is linked to certain cognitive advantages.
cognitive.zh: 双语经验与某些认知优势相关。

cognitive.en: The task measures cognitive flexibility rather than speed.
cognitive.zh: 该任务测量的是认知灵活性而非速度。

symptom.en: Fatigue is the most frequently reported symptom.
symptom.zh: 疲乏是被报告最多的症状。

symptom.en: Rising defaults were an early symptom of the credit bubble.
symptom.zh: 违约上升是信贷泡沫的早期征兆。

symptom.en: Symptoms remitted after the dosage was adjusted.
symptom.zh: 调整剂量后症状缓解了。

syndrome.en: Metabolic syndrome clusters several cardiovascular risk factors.
syndrome.zh: 代谢综合征聚集了多个心血管风险因素。

syndrome.en: The syndrome was first described in a 1936 case series.
syndrome.zh: 该综合征最早于 1936 年在一系列病例中被描述。

syndrome.en: Burnout syndrome is common among emergency clinicians.
syndrome.zh: 职业倦怠综合征在急诊临床医生中很常见。

therapy.en: Cognitive behavioral therapy reduced symptom severity by half.
therapy.zh: 认知行为疗法使症状严重程度降低了一半。

therapy.en: Gene therapy remains costly and tightly regulated.
therapy.zh: 基因治疗仍然费用高昂且受到严格监管。

therapy.en: Adjuvant therapy follows surgical removal of the tumor.
therapy.zh: 辅助治疗在手术切除肿瘤之后进行。
